changes: New: Move a right-angle connector's segments and corners by dragging their handles; a segment at an end keeps its end glued.
New: The route you set stays as the shapes move, until it would run through one of them; Reset route lays it out again.
Fix: Connectors in a drawing saved as .vsdx stay glued to their shapes when it is opened.
MCP: shape_get lists a connector's segments; shape_update takes move_segment and reset_route.
